test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 26 Jul 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
Match the columns.

 
 

 
 **Column-A (Disorder)**
 
 <strong&g

options.text: i - a, ii - b, iii - c, iv - d
i - b, ii - c, iii - a, iv - d
i - d, ii - c, iii - b, iv - a
i - b, ii - a, iii - d, iv - c

solution:
The correct answer is __**i - d, ii - c, iii - b, iv - a.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Gaucher disease** is caused by the deficiency of **glucocerebrosidase enzyme**, which leads to the accumulation of** glucocerebroside** in the **lysosomes** of cells.
 
• **Hunter syndrome** is caused by the deficiency of the e**nzyme Iduronate-2-sulfatase****,** which leads to the accumulation of **glycosaminoglycans** in the lysosomes of cells.
 
• **Tay-Sachs disease** is caused by the deficiency of the** enzyme hexosaminidase A,** which leads to the accumulation of** gangliosides** in the lysosomes of cells.
 
• **Phenylketonuria** is caused by the deficiency of **phenylalanine hydroxylase **enzyme, which leads to the accumulation of **phenylalanine** in the blood.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Gaucher disease** is a rare genetic disorder that affects the **bone marrow and spleen**, leading to **fatigue, anemia, and bone pain.**
 
• **Hunter syndrome** is a rare genetic disorder that affects the** connective tissues**, leading to** joint stiffness, coarse facial features, and delayed development.**
 
• **Tay-Sachs disease** is a rare genetic disorder that affects the **nervous system**, leading to **muscle weakness, seizures, and blindness.**
 
• **Phenylketonuria** is a rare genetic disorder that affects the** metabolism of amino acids**, leading to **intellectual disability and behavioral problems** if left untreated.
